prompt: Aldol condensation (crossed): benzaldehyde + acetone, NaOH, heat. Draw the α,β-unsaturated ketone product (dehydrated aldol = enone).
explanation: Benzaldehyde has no α-H → can only be the electrophile. Acetone's enolate attacks → β-hydroxy ketone, which dehydrates under heat (E1cb) to give the conjugated enone. Textbook crossed aldol — one partner lacks α-H to avoid self-aldol.
